data.name: Farzeena
data.gender_notes: Farzeena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of noble origin meaning 'Lady of Paradise'. Derived from the Persian word 'farz' meaning 'duty' and the Urdu suffix '-eena' meaning 'lady'. The name Farzeena carries the meaning “Lady of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farzeena usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of spiritual significance, believed to bring blessings and guidance from Allah.
data.etymology: Farzeena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farzeena total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
